description: Active MBTA service alerts — Boston subway T delays, commuter rail disruptions, shuttle replacements, track changes, detours, elevator outages. Filter by route to check one line, e.g. is the Red Line delayed right now. Example: mbta_alerts({ route: "Red" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: free MBTA v3 API key from api-v3.mbta.com for higher rate limits

route.description: Optional route id to filter, e.g. "Red", "CR-Kingston", "66"

name: mbta_alerts
title: Mbta Alerts
